subject: Optimize Toolkit: slab crediting & quantization plan
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam@edgescale.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@edgescale.ai>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Optimize Toolkit — pricing & fit questions

Hi Karthik / Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. EdgeScale is evaluating two inference vendors and we want to validate the Optimize toolkit economics before moving to procurement. A few things we need to nail down:

- How slab/commit credits map to batching and KV-cache behavior for our multi-tenant workloads (short chats + multi-turn context).
- Quantization guidance: what models and precision tiers you recommend vs visible quality tradeoffs.
- A clear discount ladder for pilot -> committed volume (we have budget constraints and need predictable unit pricing).

Can you send a strawman proposal and any data you can share on per-1000-token cost with and without prefix caching? Also list what you'd require for a 30-day POC (SLA, expected throughput, and who runs the POC).

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement tentatively expects vendor shortlists by next Friday.

Thanks,
Liam
Head of ML Platforms | EdgeScale
liam@edgescale.ai | +1 415-555-0193

Attachment: N/A
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam@edgescale.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Optimize Toolkit — pricing & fit questions

Liam — thanks for the clear ask. High level strawman below; I attached a compact PDF with numbers and assumptions.

Summary (short):
- Pilot (30 days): complimentary trial credits equivalent to 200k tokens + access to a single dedicated Optimize policy (batching + KV-prefetch) for testing.
- Slab/crediting: we propose a two-band slab model where credits applied to token unit cost drop at 250M and 1B token thresholds. Slabs are software-credited and compatible with both hosted and dedicated.
- Batching & KV-cache: typical multi-turn chat with prefix caching and continuous batching yields ~35–60% token-cost reduction depending on your turn length distribution — we included example curves in the PDF.
- Quantization: RECOMMENDATION: quantize non-retrieval encoder layers to 4-bit (int4) for gpt-like decoders; keep attention key/value in fp16 for stability on >1024 context. Expect a 1.2–1.5x cost improvement vs fp16 with <3% quality delta on our evals.

POC requirements:
- A dataset of representative prompts (we'll use your dev cluster to measure latency/throughput).
- 1 engineer from EdgeScale for integration + weekly syncs.
- We provide a pre-configured Optimize profile and 24/7 on-call for the first week.

Commercial:
- Pilot: 30 days free credits + 10% early-bird discount on first committed slab if you sign within 30 days of POC completion.
- For committed slabs we can layer a performance-backed credit: if average token TTI > agreed SLO we scale credits back; if TTI < SLO you get an additional 5% rebate.

I'll loop Ben for the formal concession language (discount ladder / SOW). Attached: redwood_slab_proposal_v1.pdf and a SOW outline.

Next steps: please confirm you want the pilot config and suggested dates — we can start as early as Nov 15.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0122

Attachment: redwood_slab_proposal_v1.pdf (5 pages)
Attachment: SOW_outline_edgescale.docx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connell <liam@edgescale.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2027 14:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Optimize Toolkit — pricing & fit questions

Quick commercial note — we can accept the slab bands above but propose a modest concession structure:

- Upfront commit credit: 8% platform credit when you commit to 250M tokens/mo; 12% at 1B tokens/mo.
- Volume ramp protection: if you ramp <60% of committed tokens in the first 3 months, we hold credits for future use instead of refunding.

If EdgeScale needs a firmer discount for procurement, we can offer a one-time commercial credit of 30k USD applied to the pilot -> first-month invoice on signature. Karthik — I marked variable areas in the PDF so sales/legal can redline.

Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: inline pricing notes (referenced in PDF)
From: Liam O'Connell <liam@edgescale.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@edgescale.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 16:48:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Optimize Toolkit — pricing & fit questions

Thanks Karthik & Ben — this is helpful. Couple follow-ups before we escalate to procurement: 

1) Can you move the pilot credit from 200k tokens to 400k? Our prod traffic is spiky and we want representative load.
2) The one-time commercial credit is attractive; we need that as a line item in the SOW (procurement wants documented offsets).
3) Quantization: can you provide the eval script + sample outputs for the int4 run on one of our representative prompts? We want to validate <3% QA delta ourselves.

We are leaning in — would accept Nov 15 start if you can confirm the pilot credit and share the eval artifacts + the SOW with the commercial credit line.

Best,
Liam
Head of ML Platforms | EdgeScale
